nodes.label: Physics Is All You Need? A Case Study in Physicist-Supervised AI Development
nodes.author: Nhat-Minh Nguyen
nodes.rationale: Quantified case study (N=1): physicist supervising Claude Code over 12 days, 57 sessions to build CLAX-PT (differentiable one-loop perturbation theory in JAX, ~2,100 lines, ≲1% accuracy).

nodes.label: CLAX-PT: Differentiable One-Loop Perturbation Theory
nodes.rationale: JAX implementation computing next-to-leading-order predictions for galaxy clustering; validates to ≲1% accuracy against CLASS-PT reference; end-to-end differentiable.

nodes.label: Supervision Protocol
nodes.rationale: Four infrastructure elements: CLASS-PT as oracle, CHANGELOG as shared memory, --fast flag for context hygiene, parallel sessions via git worktrees; two critical rules: no fudge factors, test at multiple parameter points.

nodes.label: Bug Taxonomy: Autonomy Spectrum
nodes.rationale: 15 documented issues: 10 autonomous (convention, algorithm, coefficients), 2 human-accelerated (magnitude discrepancies), 3 human-essential (architectural redesign, fudge-factor rejection, correct formula).

nodes.label: Redshift-Space Multipoles Crisis
nodes.rationale: 33 sessions (24–56) spent adjusting coefficients within wrong architecture (isotropic damping); agent could not recognize structural incompatibility; physicist diagnosed anisotropic BAO damping, triggered redesign.

nodes.label: Fudge Factor (α=0.27) Failure Mode
nodes.rationale: Agent committed calibrated scalar correction passing all oracle tests but corresponding to no quantity in reference theory; would produce wrong predictions at other cosmologies; caught and replaced by physicist.

nodes.label: Explanatory Agency Gap
nodes.rationale: Agent evaluates predictions; physicist evaluates explanations. Agent cannot spontaneously generate meta-question of whether solution frame is correct; cannot distinguish 'right numbers for right reasons' from 'right numbers for wrong reasons'.

nodes.label: Oracle Testing Limitation (P1)
nodes.rationale: Oracle tests verify 'what' not 'why'; fudge factor passed because calibrated to test point; multi-cosmology testing insufficient; defense: test at diverse parameter points, automate limiting-case probes.

nodes.label: Shared Memory Limitation (P2)
nodes.rationale: CHANGELOG prevented literal re-exploration but not structural stagnation; 33 sessions of coherent but futile work within wrong architecture; defense: session-count trigger (~5–10 sessions) for human review.

nodes.label: Irreducible Human Role (P3)
nodes.rationale: Physicist supplied 100% of decisive architectural and physical judgments despite agent performing bulk of session-time; contribution weight should reflect irreplaceability, not volume.

hyperedges.label: CLAX-PT Supervision Practices and Failure Modes
